name: Magu Magu no Mi
description: (Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)(Tag:transformation)The Magu Magu no Mi is an awful-tasting Devil Fruit granting the ability [Magma Logia](Mythical). The first to digest any part gains the ability and renders the rest inert, but gains the Curse of the Sea: unable to use energy when submerged in still water with rapidly draining stamina. Stacking two Curses of the Sea on one person kills them instantly.
